svg.aria-label: Apple M1, the die as a block diagram
svg.text: Apple M1, the die as a block diagram
Two CPU clusters share one memory side through the fabric. Arrow weight is traffic; dashed is control. Bandwidths are what one core measures.
backing L2 for the P cores too
cluster sleep states, fast IPIs through system registers
NoC port per cluster · hashed address interleave
MOESI · duplicate tags at the coherence point
L2 victim fill · all index bits hashed
DRAM bank scheduler, read and write turns
